decision: a row's Pay by change re-dates that row's waiting lines (D12, §6): writeRow reports payByChanged; updateOffering locks the live lines of the re-priced and re-dated rows in one pass (id order, after the rows), then re-prices, then re-dates the waiting lines of the rows whose pay-by moved (redateLines: LINE_DUE_MOVED rows with the reason) and counts them as dueDatesMoved; settleImpact answers it first and IMPACT_CHANGED refuses a stale count, like the session's payment due date
why: before, writeRow stored pay_by only: waiting lines kept the old due date while new ones took the new one (P2 fix report, coordinator-rework.tsv 26 Oct)
evidence: 08ze test 6 (winter session): first PUT saved:false dueDatesMoved 1, the line and the row unchanged; expected with dueDatesMoved 0 -> 409 IMPACT_CHANGED; confirmed -> the line's due_at = the row's pay_by, LINE_DUE_MOVED audited; a later line due the same date; the same body again changes nothing. Control: HEAD's offering.services.ts -> saved:true at once (no count, no re-date)
